technical.summary: EXPD shows solid long-term bullish structure (price above all major MAs, supertrend bullish, hull flip up) with recent MACD crossover, but weak trend strength (ADX 14.97), overbought stochRSI, and absent money flow confirmation limit swing entry conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (215.5) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 43 days adds event risk to an already hostile environment.
